about: The consolidation round's core share (review r3, RA-01 to RA-22 but RA-04 and RA-23): the scenarios of scenarios/37-fix-core.mjs, each a defect fixed and driven as a user reaches it, and the older scenarios the round's re-reading brought back into the acceptance. switches/fix-core.json puts each fixed defect back.

scenarios.why: RA-01: on MiniMax-Music3 with the 8B planner at F16 and four takes, the Takes tile, the go bar and the meter say one figure, and Use N takes makes the tile fit too.
RA-09: Reuse of the words already in the box makes no step and offers no Undo; with other words its Undo puts back exactly what was typed.
RA-08: every named action has a runner (the VST3 chain's + Add says the concept's words) and no placeholder part is drawn.

The Pedalboard as the concept drives it: a pedal's knob, adding a pedal already there rings it, its removal with Undo, Song info and the Cover art unit (re-read in the consolidation round, RA-06: it passes).
The go bar's layout with a song playing, 1280 at Quick (RA-06).
The same at Studio (RA-06).
The same at 1440 (RA-06).
The prompt card on YuE2 and MiniMax-Music3, with the song Generate makes (RA-06).
A factory workflow opened on a short window at Lab: the hardware shows (RA-06).
Every engine at every tier with every module: no tile collapsed or overlapping. (Re-read in the consolidation round, RA-06: it was in no acceptance list.)

The song menu and the player as the concept drives them, Open the Library included (since RC-01). (RA-06)
Ctrl+Z under an overlay and on another page edits nothing (since RC-01). (RA-06)
The stub pages and their way back (since RC-01). (RA-06)
An engine switch caps Takes at the engine's limit and holds the rest for ACE-Step (B-11, eight at most: design decision 27), and Repaint leaves an engine without it, each with its toast.

The keyboard contracts: the reels are one slider (End to eight), a number box keeps focus on Enter and Escape, an XY pad answers End and Page Down, a nudge takes Shift off auto, tap tempo reaches the field's range.
A key ends the reels' pointer preview and the LCD shows the value set (L-32); a double-click on a reel is a click on it (L-22).
Takes held for ACE-Step say so on MiniMax-Music3's tile until a change there clears it (E-39, S-10).

An engine switch there and back: values in the new engine's range, the other engine's adapters not loaded, the song travels, each engine keeps its models, the first engine's desk as it was, after a reload too, and a switch is one undo step (B-01, B-02, B-19, B-48).
The lead sheet's lyric-timing line warns when composer CFG leaves auto and Set CFG to auto clears it (B-09; no cross-module paint, design decision P3c-9).
Typing a seed keeps the tile's height (Q-23), the Sampler strip's label rows are one height (Q-24), an automatic value says what auto means, two wheel keys in one frame both count (Q-33).
A starter of the empty desk puts focus on the new tile's grip (Q-16); a card of the Modules panel keeps it (F-25, design decision 7); an empty Quick desk offers its starters (Q-42).
Ctrl+Z in the description takes back the typing, and outside it goes on back through the setting and then the rest of the typing, never forward (F-06).

Generate: an empty prompt refused with an example, one card per take and the count in the title (design decision P6-2), Ctrl+Enter queues another, × cancels one, Cancel all and its Undo and Redo, finished songs as cards with their take badge, unheard marks (C-11, C-45, F-13).

Each engine's own run: MiniMax-Music3 does not start a run that cannot fit (design decision P6-1), ACE-Step plans in passes, YuE2 with Preview opens the score first, Stable Audio 3 and HeartMuLa ask for their prompt and tags, a latent run says it continues, wildcards expand at Generate.
Opening a workflow is one step, undone from its toast it reverses only itself and leaves what was typed since; Redo by its toast, Ctrl+Shift+Z, Ctrl+Y and the Redo button (S-03).
The theme's three segments, kept under the page's own key over a reload, arrow keys round to System (C-40); the other pages, F9 and Ctrl+Enter doing nothing there, Create coming back.

The seed manager: Roll, Random, a typed seed refused or kept, Escape, blur, the lock, the save form (Escape, Enter, update, Cancel), stars, loading, search, delete with its two steps and Undo, From saved, and the LM seed link at Lab with the planner on the desk (design decision 31).
Saved, Undo and Redo stay 16 px clear of the tier switch with a long Undo label and a Redo, and the Undo arrow keeps its size (F-02), at 1600 on Studio.
The same at 1920 on Quick (F-02).
The same at 1280 on Quick (F-02).
The same at 1000 on Lab (F-02).
With two and three adapters and 4 to 30 sections, at Lab and Studio, every section chip lies inside its cartridge, wide enough for its tag, and the sixteenth can be pressed (L-03), at 1920x1080.
The same at 1280x720 (L-03).
Side units' power and remove named for what they do, foot switches say Turn on and Turn off, a pedal's unit rides small after its number, the count of side units on (Q-11, L-20, Q-31).

Every value change is a step named for what it did: a key press, a held key, a drag, the Undo button's words, Ctrl+Z and Redo, a click clearing Redo, auto as a value, the history keeping the last hundred (S-03).

On HeartMuLa a held length says so under its ruler (S-10), Takes is a strip saying the takes wait (S-37), the lyric sheet says empty means instrumental (S-08), HeartMuLa never runs past the cap (S-07), auto off starts where auto was (S-17), Beat I/O that does not fit says so (S-39).

A tempo chip is added after the user's words (S-04), looks pressed (S-02), is one undo step (S-03); a chip of its group replaces only the item; Ctrl+Z takes back the chips, newest first, then the typing.
Dragging the BPM figure shows the BPM and never leaves it in typing mode (Q-02).
Stable Audio 3's words for its box: the Length tile, Write it for me, the box's accessible name and Drafts say prompt (S-05, S-33).
Choosing APG in the Sampler shows the Guidance plugin's pad with its value and read-outs in the first frame (S-03).
An engine switch that changes what a length means says so in its toast (S-37).

waiting.because: The engine switch's toast does not yet say that on HeartMuLa a length is the longest the song may run; nothing builds it today.
